tasks.analysis: Future progress of the current education system in America is dependent on the implementation of an early education program. As research has demonstrated, there are tremendous gaps between the school readiness of children from various social economic backgrounds. In order for all children to be prepared for kindergarten, there must be a universal accessibility to a proper policy driven early childhood education system. 美国现有教育体系的未来发展取决于早期教育项目的实施。正如研究表明的那样，不同社会经济背景的儿童在入学准备程度上存在巨大差距。为了让所有儿童都能为幼儿园阶段做好准备，必须建立一个由政策驱动、全民可及的适宜的幼儿早期教育体系。
